{{Top|leg}}
The '''Tol Velmoc mountains''' were a rugged range of peaks located on the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Velmor/Legends|Velmor]]. The mountains were riddled with tunnels and caverns. The insectile race known as the [[Velmoc]] was all but extinct by the time of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]], but a few stragglers remained hidden away in this mountain chain.

==History==
During the height of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]], [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] who resisted the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] rule of Velmor hid within the Tol Velmoc's caves for safety. [[Zeta Traal]], a member of the [[Imperial Diplomatic Corps/Legends|Imperial Diplomatic Corps]], had, at some point, ordered the mountains to sustain an orbital bombardment. The message was interecepted, however, and the mountain region was spared.

[[Ergric Betos]], a bodyguard for the Velmor royalty, was banished to the Tol Vemoc Mountains where he subsequently joined the [[Velmoc-Dac]] tribe.
